label: Rancher
note: The armed locals hanging about a ranch village (src/systems/world/ranches.gd): a local guard's rifle and nerve, standing round the fire or by the gate, while the locals hold the village's outpost (src/systems/world/remnant_outposts.gd; the Remnant's troopers stand there while they hold it), in the locals' garrison there (nowhere to walk, so they stand and look about now and then). The racers' outpost has them too, run by its own Townsfolk. Fight them and the village fights back; the port does not hear of it.
